description: Updates the project asset model based on keys in the request body

parameters.name: acknowledge_warnings
parameters.description: When true, acknowledges field-default warnings and applies default values for read-only fields whose current value differs from the configured default.

parameters.name: wrap_custom_fields
parameters.description: When true, wraps each custom field value as {"value": ...} and renames "name" to "label" inside LOV objects.

parameters.name: custom_field_format
parameters.description: Custom field encoding. 'standard' (default) uses the existing published 200 schema; 'mobile' returns a bounded subset (AssetMobileResponse) with each custom field as {data_type, value} and (on upda...

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Locale for localized response messages (for example: en, fr-FR, pseudo)

200.description: Asset updated successfully. When conditional WARNING rules apply, the body is AssetUpdateWarningResponse with conditional_warnings; otherwise SingleAssetResponse.

400.description: The server could not understand the request due to invalid syntax or parameters that fail to meet validation requirements.

401.description: Although the HTTP standard specifies "unauthorized", semantically this response means "unauthenticated". That is, the client must authenticate itself to get the requested response.

403.description: The client does not have access rights to the content; that is, it is authenticated, but the server is refusing to give the requested resource. Unlike 401, the client's identity is known to the server.

404.description: The server can not find the requested resource. This can mean either the URL is not recognized, or the resource itself does not exist. Servers may also send this response instead of 403 to hide the existence of a resource from an unauthorized client.

422.description: The request was well-formed but was unable to be followed due to semantic errors.

schema.description: Asset update request. All fields are optional - only provided fields will be updated.

asset_type_id.description: Asset type ID. Must have Is Asset enabled for that type. If asset type is changed, all custom fields will be reset and only the ones provided in this request will be set.

notes.description: Notes by context. Keys are context identifiers; value is the note text. Supported keys: "asset_status" (stored only when status is changed in this request), "project_assignment" (stored when provid...

asset_code.description: Unique identifier for the asset (also referred to as asset_code in API)

description.description: Description of the asset. Pass null to clear the value.

location_id.description: Location ID. Pass null to clear the value.

trade_id.description: Trade ID. Pass null to clear the value.

latitude.description: Latitude must be provided together with longitude, or both must be omitted. Pass null to clear.

longitude.description: Longitude must be provided together with latitude, or both must be omitted. Pass null to clear.

parent_asset_id.description: Parent asset ID. Pass null to remove parent (make standalone). The parent must exist, belong to the same company, and be in the same asset type hierarchy.

profile_image_id.description: Profile image FAS ID. Pass null to clear the value.
